info.title: TraceWeaver API
info.description: Public/core/scorer interfaces. 36 operations implemented in source, including opt-in stateful sandbox, case-bound commands and immutable source verification. Non-sandbox workspaces retain their existing closure policy. See backend/LAB_SANDBOX.md.

get.description: Operator/reviewer with read grants for every run source. Returns active operator/reviewer members with full run source read scope, including group grants. Current eligibility only; transitions still enforce state, version and permissions. No identity display names are stored.
Validated Identity subject and memberships. Roles are per workspace; admin does not imply source access.
Viewer/operator/reviewer or admin with source read grants. Returns only granted sources; ingest credential does not imply read access.

post.description: Service token restricted to this source. Envelope 1-500 records, HTTP body <=1 MiB. Each record validates against EventInput independently; invalid record becomes rejected, valid records continue. Same source_event_id and canonical content = duplicate; changed content = per-item SOURCE_EVENT_CONFLICT. Server owns IDs/received_at/provenance/parser_version. Redact before persistence/logging. Unique key survives retries indefinitely; no Idempotency-Key needed. Compressed request bodies return 415. Records are revalidated after redaction. Timestamps support exact microseconds; nonzero fractional digits beyond 6 reject per record as UNSUPPORTED_TIMESTAMP_PRECISION.

get.description: Sort occurred_at,event_id; fixed snapshot across cursor pages. Apply source ACL before search/counts.

post.description: Operator/reviewer only, with current read grants for every requested source. Root must belong to scope/window. Max window 1h and 1000 events before candidate filtering; 422 WINDOW_TOO_LARGE, never truncate. Freeze event IDs, full requested source scope and rule policy atomically with audit. Initial bounded execution completes in the request transaction; 202 returns completed Run and Location to poll. Same actor/workspace/route Idempotency-Key replays the committed response for 24h after rechecking current authorization; different canonical normalized input returns 409. No key creates a new run. Hybrid currently completes degraded=true, reason=ai_unavailable, effective_method=rule_only because scorer is not configured; requested mode stays hybrid. See backend/RECONSTRUCTION.md for the pinned sandbox action policy and limits.

Location.description: URL to poll the created run

get.description: Require current grants for all sources in the run; revoked grant blocks the whole artifact.
Completed run only; otherwise 409 RUN_NOT_READY. Evidence is redacted, missing expected steps mean no evidence, not a fabricated outcome. Recheck grants for whole artifact.

post.description: Operator/reviewer with current read grants for every run source. Append-only history, required reason/expected_version; stale ->409, cycle ->422. Latest review overlays immutable link evidence; review and audit share one transaction. Any closed case for the run blocks graph edits with409 CASE_CLOSED until reopened.

Operator/reviewer with current read grants for every run source; server sets manual/pending, null score and reason evidence. Endpoints must belong to the immutable run snapshot. Self-link/cycle ->422, duplicate pair ->409 even if rejected; cannot replace prior links. Mutations serialize per run and commit with audit. Any closed case for the run blocks graph edits with409 CASE_CLOSED until reopened.
Operator/reviewer; case starts new. Workflow engine is the sole state source, no competing case state column.

get.description: Current full run-source scope, including empty sources. New/assigned are waiting states. Optional inclusive UTC from/to filter parent run created_at, matching dashboard. Live state/owner filters, UUID ascending cursor binds actor/workspace/filters/limit/current scope; no immutable case-list snapshot.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on parent run created_at (UTC).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on parent run created_at (UTC).

post.description: Operator/reviewer with full current run-source grants; event references must belong to exact run snapshot. Notes are redacted. Closed case returns409 until reopen. Evidence append and audit are atomic; workflow version is unchanged.

assign: operator/reviewer, valid owner with full scope; start/request_verification: owner or reviewer; verify_close/verification_failed/reopen: reviewer. Version required; stale 409, invalid action/guard 422, role 403. Verification needs note/evidence; close conservatively requires no pending link anywhere in run, then freezes all run graph edits. Reopen needs a reason different from last close and valid owner. Case state/owner derive only from workflow history. Preserve state+history+audit atomically.

get.description: One statement snapshot of current membership/reader role and full requested run-source grants, including empty sources. Inclusive UTC from/to filter parent run created_at for every counter. Unresolved events count per-run event occurrences outside the root component of pending/accepted live links in completed runs. Waiting cases are new/assigned from latest workflow history. Echoed filters apply unchanged to listCases; run detail/graph require known IDs (no global run-list route).

post.description: Internal app JWT (distinct client and configured service subject) plus independently verified end-user JWT; both require active workspace membership. X-Workspace-Id must match body workspace_id and creator_subject must match verified user. Creates standalone workspace-scoped document_review v1/document entities; no document content is stored. Case workflows are created by createCase; duplicate core case creation returns409 after current source ACL. Server definitions only. Entity uniqueness409; no Idempotency-Key support.

Verified app plus end-user JWT and current DB permissions. Definition/role/owner/guard/expected_version enforced; history and audit commit atomically. Case transitions share case repository and run lock, evidence/close/reopen guards; supplied evidence_refs must belong to that case, server records full current evidence. document_review v1 rejects owner/evidence refs. Stale version409; no Idempotency-Key support.

get.description: Verified app JWT plus independently verified user JWT, X-Workspace-Id and current memberships/reader role. Case instances also require current read grants for every requested run source including empty sources. Returns persisted definition identity, latest state/version and sanitized history; no internal facts or definition payload.

post.description: Internal only, timeout 5s, max100 pairs, no DB writes. Invalid schema ->422 whole batch; model unavailable ->503. Caller enforces exact pair_id set (no missing/extra/duplicate), finite [0,1] scores and feature_schema_version; mismatch/timeout ->degraded rule-only plus audit. Score is not claimed to be calibrated probability.

servers.description: Private Python scorer; development loopback only. Not served by the Node API.

get.summary: Read persisted sandbox state; requires all three source grants

post.summary: Opt in once; administrator with three source read grants
Execute sandbox command: capacity/image/account admin; submit/provision operator or reviewer

request_id.description: Stable request code, e.g. LAB-001. The request ID and derived account/image IDs must remain unchanged by ingestion redaction; otherwise 400 INVALID_INPUT before state or log creation. Existing identifiers are not rewritten.

get.summary: Inspect current simulated environment; does not persist case verification
Read immutable source checks with current case and sandbox grants

post.summary: Reviewer checks authoritative sandbox source and persists passed/failed/inconclusive; empty input only

get.summary: Read bound simulated request, conditions, attempts and log delivery

post.summary: Execute command bound to case root; requires case and lab versions; closed case rejected

coreWorkspace.name: X-Workspace-Id
coreWorkspace.description: Explicit workspace scope; must equal WorkflowCreate.workspace_id. Both service and user need active membership.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque; binds filters, grants/scope and sort. Event pages use a fixed input snapshot; mismatched filter/scope returns 400.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional for initial creation, required to retry POST safely. Actor+workspace+route scoped for 24h; same key/body replays response; changed body returns 409.

404.description: Not found or outside source/workspace scope

413.description: Body exceeds 1 MiB; no records written

userBearer.description: User access token; verify signature/issuer/audience/expiry, then current membership/roles/grants.

ingestBearer.description: Ingest service access token with explicit source scope; not a user read token.

appServiceBearer.description: App access JWT with distinct CORE_APP_CLIENT_ID azp and exact CORE_APP_SUBJECT sub. Requires active workspace membership; empty CORE_APP_SUBJECT disables core503. Pair with delegatedUserBearer; never send app credentials to browser.

delegatedUserBearer.name: X-End-User-Authorization
delegatedUserBearer.description: Bearer <original user access JWT>. Core independently verifies signature/issuer/audience/expiry/user client. Current user roles and grants come from DB, never arbitrary actor headers. Send only through a trusted server over HTTPS.

scorerServiceSecret.description: Internal scorer service credential via Authorization; never delivered to frontend.

items.description: Historical immutable attempt snapshot; checker-v1 entries retained. Checker-v2 fields described by LabAttempt.

anyOf.description: Legacy checker-v1 attempt; result cannot pass until rerun
